summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

size.note: Track and thumb size: medium 32x18px track with a 16px thumb, small 24x14px track with a 12px thumb. The registered size aliases map default and sm.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (alias of selected in the API vocabulary). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. Also set by a disabled <fieldset> ancestor without changing the attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; draws the pill track and positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; fills the track, receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Decorative circle that slides to the end of the track while on (mirrored in rtl).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with the primary color and the thumb moves to the end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated mixin: setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError), formResetCallback restores the default checked attribute, disabled and disabled-fieldset are not submitted, formStateRestore restores checked.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x18px (medium) or 24x14px (small), under 24px tall; the label beside it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009)

aria: role=switch with native checked state exposed as aria-checked (on/off)
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: An on/off setting that takes effect right away, or a binary preference in a settings form
Format or consequence of the setting needs explaining
The setting must be on before submit
useCases.use: required with a label that states what is enabled

useCases.when: Space is tight and the setting is secondary

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that is only recorded when the form is submitted, such as agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: Checkboxes record a choice; a switch reads as acting at once

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch is a single on/off value

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch labeled with the state, like "On"
antiPatterns.why: The label is the only name for the switch and the state is already announced
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that names the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default bg-input is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

drift.contract: thumb size plus twice the border width, from existing tokens
drift.realization: shadcn uses 1.15rem (18.4px); no semantic token has that value

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern, label row beside the track, two sizes.

openQuestions.question: How is the switch built: native input with role=switch, or a custom element with ARIA?
openQuestions.recommendation: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> inside the shadow root, through FormAssociated + NativeControl, like Checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: Native input with role=switch. It gives Space, focus, validity and the label link for free; no ARIA state to keep in sync.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute, and is there an indeterminate state?
openQuestions.recommendation: Same as Checkbox: checked is not reflected (the attribute is the reset default). No indeterminate: a switch is binary.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes, like Checkbox and Input; hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which size values, and under which names?
openQuestions.recommendation: The shared size vocabulary: medium (default) and small; the registered size aliases cover default and sm.
openQuestions.answer: size = medium | small, default medium, reflected.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.recommendation: Native semantics: it must be on to submit (valueMissing while off), as with a native required checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: Must be on; the form blocks submission while off.

openQuestions.question: How is the track height set when no semantic token holds the visual reference's 18.4px?
openQuestions.recommendation: Derive it from existing tokens (thumb size plus twice the border width) and list the difference as drift, rather than adding a semantic token for one value.
openQuestions.answer: Derived: 18px medium, 14px small. Listed in realizations.web.drift.

openQuestions.question: Is the plan approved?
openQuestions.recommendation: Proceed on the recommendations; the person can revisit any of them.
openQuestions.answer: No one was available to approve in this session. The recommended answer was taken for every question above (SB-0101); implementation still waits for the person to confirm.
